build.description: Default implementation agent; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on OpenRouter.

funcequiv-oai.description: Functional-equivalence work on the OpenAI subscription. OpenRouter alternative: @differential-harness and @standards-oracle.
funcequiv-oai.prompt: Use the `evidence-review` skill before beginning work. Functional-equivalence work: differential fixtures, observability, non-vacuity, mutation coverage, and independent Recommendation-based oracles. Do not conflate harness work with reconstruction source work, and keep blob-faithful and standards-conformant behaviour separate. Report explicit non-vacuity denominators. Before retaining a fixture/harness or oracle conclusion, obtain both `@evidence-review` and `@final-review`. This is the OpenAI-subscription path; the OpenRouter primaries are `@differential-harness` and `@standards-oracle`.

partial-link-or.description: OpenRouter continuity path for @partial-link when OpenAI usage is exhausted.
partial-link-or.prompt: Use the `reconstruction-experiment` skill before beginning work. Investigate partial-link, translation-unit ordering, relocation, section and symbol-order fidelity for issues #20 and #6. This is the OpenRouter continuity path for `@partial-link`: state why escalation is needed, work from a compact evidence packet rather than raw logs, and apply the same experiment and retention rules.
